cases.goal: Fix app.py totals: amounts for repeated categories must accumulate instead of overwriting earlier rows. Preserve empty input and negative amounts. Change only app.py; do not modify self_check.py. Leave unrelated operations unchanged.

Fix app.py ordered: sort strings case-insensitively using Unicode casefold, preserving input order for equal casefold keys. Return a new list without changing the input. Change only app.py; do not modify self_check.py. Leave unrelated operations unchanged.
